members.name: John B. Sawyer
members.title: Founder, Principal & Chief Executive Officer
members.bio: John B. Sawyer is the Founder, Principal, and Chief Executive Officer of Hemisphere Aerospace Investments, providing executive leadership across HAI and Hemisphere Defense. With more than 35 years in commercial aerospace, including three decades in executive and board-level roles, he directs the company's commercial strategy, investor relations, and new business development. A precision deal-maker with a global network, he has originated, negotiated, and closed more than 250 aircraft transactions, including a principal role in the 2003 US Airways acquisition of 105 aircraft, one of the largest used-aircraft transactions in history. He also launched a 737-400 passenger-to-freighter conversion program spanning more than 40 aircraft, with recent B737-800 sales and retrofits for SpaceX and RTX Corporation.

members.name: Craig McPike
members.title: Chair, Board of Strategy & Oversight
members.bio: Craig McPike, Brigadier General, U.S. Air Force Retired, chairs the Board of Strategy and Oversight for Hemisphere Defense, guiding defense strategy, program oversight, and senior engagement with government, allied, and industry partners. He brings more than 32 years of leadership, including command of organizations exceeding 12,000 personnel, direction of multi-billion-dollar defense portfolios, and service as Deputy Director of Operations (Deputy J3) for U.S. Southern Command. A command pilot with more than 4,000 flight hours in the KC-135 and C-17, he applies decades of operational leadership to advancing autonomous maritime and unmanned defense systems.

members.name: Alex Hart
members.title: Chief Financial Officer
members.bio: Alex Hart serves as Chief Financial Officer for Hemisphere Aerospace Investments and Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, bringing experience across financial operations, accounting, government contracting, and regulatory compliance. Within the defense sector, he helped scale a finance and accounting organization from approximately 30 to more than 200 employees, directed cash disbursement operations responsible for approximately $1.5 billion in subcontractor payments, and supported financial strategy associated with roughly $2.5 billion in government contract funding. His prior experience includes managing financial operations tied to more than $400 million in real estate assets across a nationwide portfolio. A graduate of Texas A&M University with a Bachelor of Science in Accounting, he brings a disciplined approach to financial strategy, compliance, and operational planning.

members.name: Chip Fichtner
members.title: Head of Engineering
members.bio: Chip Fichtner serves as Head of Engineering for Hemisphere Defense, leading system and platform engineering, technical design, engineering standards, and program execution across development efforts. He brings more than 40 years as an engineering and operations executive, including service as an Executive Director at RTX, where he led large engineering, manufacturing, quality, and program-management organizations. His career spans P&L responsibility from $5 million to $900 million and teams of more than 500 across domestic and international operations, with expertise in advanced manufacturing, Lean operations, and complex systems integration. He is recognized for recovering underperforming programs and building disciplined organizations that deliver complex work reliably, experience he now applies to Hemisphere Defense's engineering and program development.

members.name: Dalton Sawyer
members.title: Technical Director
members.bio:
Dalton Sawyer serves as Technical Director for Hemisphere Aerospace Investments and Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, providing technical leadership across commercial and defense programs. He works closely with engineering teams, program leadership, and strategic partners to ensure technical requirements, systems integration, and engineering efforts remain aligned with mission objectives and program goals.

Dalton's responsibilities include technical planning, engineering coordination, systems integration, and the development of technical standards that support complex aerospace initiatives. He helps translate program requirements into practical engineering solutions while coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure projects are executed efficiently, reliably, and in alignment with the strategic objectives of HAI and HAD.

members.name: Austin Fichtner
members.title: Technology Strategy & Integration
members.bio: Austin Fichtner supports technology strategy, systems integration, and industrialization across Hemisphere Aerospace Defense programs, helping translate emerging technologies and complex engineering concepts into scalable, operational capabilities. His work spans advanced manufacturing, autonomy and sensing technologies, digital systems, and the production strategies that move programs from early development toward deployment. He previously served as Innovation Director at Cresting Wave and founded ElectriFit, an IoT and AI-enabled technology company that was successfully developed through acquisition. At HAD, he focuses on integration planning, manufacturing readiness, verification strategy, and the transition of advanced technologies into deployable systems. He holds a B.B.A. in Entrepreneurship from Baylor University.

members.name: Rob Riedell
members.title: Programs & Procurement
members.bio: Rob leads program execution and procurement across HAI and Hemisphere Defense. His work includes contracting, purchasing, supplier coordination, material and service sourcing, and tracking cost, schedule, and supplier performance to keep programs organized, supplied, and moving forward.
